title: Finch Circle Birthday Reward — Note Value and Validity by Tier
content:
The birthday reward of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program is a Finch Note issued in the member's birth month. Its value and validity differ by tier; the membership age it requires is the same at every tier.

| Tier | Birthday note value (USD) | Birthday note validity (calendar days) | Days the membership must have existed before the first day of the birth month |
|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | not applicable (no birthday reward) | not applicable | 30 |
| Finch Circle Silver | 10.00 | 30 | 30 |
| Finch Circle Gold | 15.00 | 30 | 30 |
| Finch Circle Platinum | 20.00 | 30 | 30 |
| Finch Circle Diamond | 25.00 | 45 | 30 |
| Finch Circle Icon | 50.00 | 60 | 30 |

## Definitions

- **Birthday note value** — the value of the birthday Finch Note issued in the member's birth month, USD to 2 decimals, or not applicable when the tier has no birthday reward.
- **Birthday note validity** — the calendar days of validity of the birthday note, counting the issue date as day 1, or not applicable.
- **Minimum membership age** — the calendar days the membership must have existed before the first day of the birth month for a birthday note.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- A Finch Circle Diamond member's birthday note is worth 25.00 and is valid for 45 days with the issue date as day 1.
- A Finch Circle Member tier membership has no birthday reward; its value column reads not applicable.
